title: feat(push): requires push and the stack push key mount PushServicePlugin under os serve
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY61hHdLdFdzwXbxaNtv58y)_

Fixes #29820

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #29969 (skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json: no eval asks for `requires: ['push']` or the `push` key); this diff teaches both in `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (the top-level key enumeration and the `requires` table) and in the new `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/push-service.mdx`

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`requires: ['push']` 加上栈定义里新的顶层 `push` 键，`objectstack serve`（和 `@objectstack/verify` 的 `bootStack`）就会挂上 `PushServicePlugin`，不再需要宿主代码；托管 relay（含不写 `push` 键、`push: {}`）与内联密钥在启动时被拒，报错写明原因与改法。
- **为什么改**：此前只有在代码里手动组合插件才有推送服务，按栈文件运行的部署里 `notify` 选 `push` 渠道无处投递；relay 发送端尚未上线，若照常启动会挂上推送渠道、把每条推送都答成已发送而实际什么都没发出。
- **风险与回滚**：纯增量：只有声明 `requires: ['push']` 的栈会走新路径，未声明的启动不变；回滚即回退本 PR。唯一新增的启动失败是"声明了 push 却只配了 relay（或没配）"，这是本卡要求的拒绝。
- **先看**：① `packages/services/service-push/src/capability-arg.ts`（relay 与 schema 拒绝及其报错文字）② `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts` 的 `push` 分支（serve 与 verify 共用的一条规则）③ `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 的两处改动（Tier H，受管面）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/serve-stack-email-sms-door.contract.test.ts`，预期 push 段全部通过：direct 配置注册出 vendors 为 `['apns']` 的推送服务，无键 / `{}` / relay 三种都以 "its sender has not shipped … transport: 'direct'" 被拒。
- **需要你做的**：本 PR 触及 `skills/**`（Tier H），需要一位 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 维护者批准后才能合并。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`**
  - `push` joins `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS`, provided by `@objectstack/service-push`, edition `open`. It is requested, never always-on, because its schema default (the relay) is refused at boot.
  - The stack definition gains a top-level `push` key (`PushServiceConfigSchema`, secrets by `credentialRef` only) with a `COMPOSE_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` row `single`, classified `deployment` in the unmanaged-install table and listed among the artifact-envelope keys.
  - `push-config.zod.ts`'s docblock now names the stack key and `objectstack serve` as its reader. Only `PushRelayTransportConfigSchema` keeps `[PLANNED — not yet served]`.
- **`@objectstack/core`**: `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS.push` names `PushServicePlugin`, and `resolveCapabilityArgument('push', …)` reads `resolvePushCapabilityArg` off the provider module, as the `email` and `sms` readers are read. One rule serves both `objectstack serve` and `bootStack`.
- **`@objectstack/service-push`**: `resolvePushCapabilityArg(stack.push)` parses the key and throws, before the kernel boots:
  - on the relay (absent key, `null`, `{}`, `transport: 'relay'`): `PUSH_RELAY_NOT_SERVED_MESSAGE` (names the missing relay sender, prescribes `transport: 'direct'` with an `apns` and/or `fcm` block), plus where the key is written on this boot path;
  - on anything the schema refuses, an inline secret first among them: each path and the schema's guidance, never the value. A block with no `transport` has its `invalid_union` opened to the member the schema's own rule picks, so the guidance is not lost to "Invalid input".
  - On a stack that requires `push`, either refusal fails the boot as `Capability "push" (@objectstack/service-push) failed to start: …`.
- **`@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/verify`**: depend on `@objectstack/service-push`, so the provider the open-edition token names resolves out of the box. The cli's vitest config gains the anchored source alias.
- **Docs**: a new `services.push` page (`content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/push-service.mdx`): the two vendors, credential references, the relay's not-served status and its boot message, the device routes, dead-token retirement and the grading table; index rows in the runtime-services index, the kernel index and the versioning matrix. The generated `push-config` reference is regenerated.
- **Skill** (`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, Tier H): `push` is added to the top-level key enumeration (the required gate `check:skill-top-level-keys` refuses the diff without it) and to the `requires` table. The new tokens are paid for in the same file by deleting a stale path and count ("registry in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` — its 19 opt-in entries" becomes "registry in `@objectstack/core`"; the registry moved to core and holds more than 19 entries).
  - File: 429 → 429 lines, 6011 → 6004 tokens (ceiling 6007 before this diff's deletion paid it).
  - Bundle (every `SKILL.md`): 4539 → 4539 lines; whole shipped tree 224969 tokens after, 7 fewer than before (this is the only `skills/**` file touched).

## Why

Ruling C on #29820: the token, the key and the `os serve` reader land together, so no released version has a `push` token that boots to nothing or a key nothing reads. The relay is refused rather than served because a served relay would mount the messaging `push` channel and answer every push `sent` while nothing left the server. A token with no `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` row is not dropped silently: a new reverse pin asserts every open-edition token has a serve mount.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.test.ts`: the token, its package and edition, not always-on, `classify` installable.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-email-sms.test.ts`: the key: a direct block is carried through; a vendor block without `transport` reads as direct; relay, `{}` and absence are accepted at authoring; verdict parity with `PushServiceConfigSchema`; disposition `single`; an inline `key` refused at `['push','apns']` with `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`/422, value not echoed; a secret pasted into `credentialRef` refused; compose names `push`.
- `packages/services/service-push/src/capability-arg.test.ts` (new): the direct argument constructs a plugin that registers `push`; absent / `null` / `{}` / relay / staging relay are refused with the relay message; inline APNs key, PEM in `credentialRef`, a relay credential and a vendor-less direct block are refused with their guidance and no echoed value.
- `packages/core/src/capability-composition.test.ts`: the reader is called with `stack.push` only (`{}` when absent); its refusal propagates; a provider module without the export is refused by name.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-stack-email-sms-door.contract.test.ts`: serve composition: the table row; `resolveServedCapabilities(['push'])` contains push and `([])` does not; a direct block reaches the plugin and init registers vendors `['apns']`; no key / `{}` / relay refused with the relay message; a raw-config inline `serviceAccount` refused, value not echoed.
- `packages/cli/test/serve-capability-vocabulary.test.ts`: new reverse pin, every open-edition token has a serve mount (a provider entry or a tier); `serve-capability-identity.test.ts` gains the push plugin name; `option-b-reader-acceptance.pin.test.ts` lists `push` among envelope keys.
- `packages/verify/src/harness.served-composition.test.ts`: `bootStack` mounts the push plugin from a direct `fcm` block; a plain boot has none; `requires: ['push']` with no key rejects with the relay refusal.

## Acceptance notes

- ADR-0012 is not edited (#29817 owns it).
- The relay sender itself is out of scope (#29920).
- Not in this diff: the platform skill's `requires` table already omitted `mailbox` and `package-registry` before this change; noted for the skills lane, not fixed here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local test runs (all under scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh)</summary>

- Full build `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2`: 120/120 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0; `@objectstack/spec` rebuilt again after the last spec src change, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 808/808 files, 24288 passed, 1 todo. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 89/89 files, 1524/1524 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 377/377 files, 5316/5316 tests. cli typecheck exit 0. The integration tier was not run locally: the diff touches no spawn entry, so CI runs it.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test` and typecheck: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-push test` and typecheck: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify test`: 48/48 files, 408/408 tests; typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 311 passed, 4 skipped files; 22320 passed, 26 skipped tests.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over the 19 changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files: exit 0. CI runs the full `pnpm lint`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the relay boot refusal</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned `if (config.transport !== 'direct') {` in `packages/services/service-push/src/capability-arg.ts` into `if (false /* ablated-29820 */) {` (anchor count 1 → 0, blob 8638e2857a5c → 2c1a8ad32f78).

- Ablated: `src/capability-arg.test.ts` 5 failed / 7 passed (all five relay rows: absent, `null`, `{}`, `transport: 'relay'`, staging endpoint); cli `serve-stack-email-sms-door.contract.test.ts` 3 failed / 7 passed (no key, `{}`, relay).
- Restored: blob back to HEAD 8638e2857a5c, `git diff HEAD` empty; the same two files 12/12 and 10/10.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates: dispatch-gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 142 commands on the final tree, each run and its exit code recorded; all 142 exit 0.
- `--ran`: "142 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 142 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- Four gates were red on the first pass and are fixed in this diff: `check:skill-top-level-keys` (push missing from the skill's key list), `check:test-source-alias` (cli vitest alias), `check:docs-audit-scope` (the new page in the audit scope), and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3 from a shallow clone; green after fetching its base commit).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated`: exit 0.
- `check-changeset-no-major` with this body: exit 0 ("no `major` bump"; LEVEL AXIS ✓ for `yes (widening)` and `added`; no moved package graded `patch`). Control: the same diff declared `Metadata-protocol: none` exits 1, refused only because the entries are graded `minor`.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. ESLint over the 19 changed files passes; the full `pnpm lint` is left to CI.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
